QuestInfo.name: Red Leaf High: Secrets of War
QuestInfo.1: Principal Nobunaga will teach you a secret skill if you collect all of the Sengoku Totems with Oda Coins.
QuestInfo.2: You learned the Warring States Manifesto skill by collecting all Sengoku Totems.

0.0: I am offering a challenge. Any who may face my judgment and prove themselves as worthy of a passing grade will receive a full scholarship to MY new school
0.1: If you collect a large scholarship, I may even allow you to trade your winnings for my special totems. Objects of GREAT power. \r\nBut perhaps I have said too much. Your abilities have yet to be tested.

yes.0: I will allow you access to the teachings of the greatest generals of my world, IF you can collect all 3 Sengoku Totems.\r\nDo you have the heart to attempt this trial?

no.0: You don't care about education at all!

default.0: Put the 3 Sengoku Totems in your Equip tab.
